notes.title: 0.6.5 - Hardest Places to Play
notes.content:
Small patch to add in a table displaying a ranking for hardest places to play, along with a couple other small changes. Should be compatible with 0.6.4.

* Added a ranking for hardest places to play, which displays home record, fan rating, and distribution of hardcore/casual/fairweather fans for each team.
* Reworked player heights and weights, made sure Cs and PFs had appropriate heights
* fixed bug with weights introduced by last update's ability to mod player weights

notes.title: 0.6.4 introducing professional league simulation!
notes.content:
If you'd like to join the playtest, join the mailing list here: collegebasketballmanager.com/JoinBeta


This update brings with it a new professional simulation! Several new features have been included:

A background simulation of an american professional basketball league. This league is simulated in a more simple manner than the normal simulation for college games for performance reasons. 
After a couple weeks into the regular season, you’ll be able to view an overview of the league, including all-star voting, MVP voting, rookie of the year voting, and team standings.
With this comes the possibility that players leave early for the draft. Throughout the season, you can view the “Big Board” showing the projected draft order for the professional league
On each individual player and a team’s roster page, you can view a player’s chances to go pro. This depends on their personality, performance, and projected draft pick
Once the season completes, you can watch the professional draft unfold.
Now, the “Pro Potential” grade for each team is calculated dynamically based on where your players went in the draft as well as how they performed in the professional league. More Allstars and MVPs = higher grade!
Editing pro team data and pro player data is possible through local mods, as well, if you want to edit in real pro teams and pro players!

Other additions:
Can now edit college player data. Still not ready to add/remove players or teams, but just changing the data works! This would allow you to change player names, hometowns, attributes, or any other data relevant for them.

Other bug fixes:
Local mod folders now auto-generate if they aren’t already there upon launching the game. So if you aren’t seeing the local mod folders, try to launch the game first, then check in MyDocuments/College_BBall/Mods
fixed bug not granting some tournament achievements to coaches
fixed bug where sometimes team ratings wouldn't update after coach was added/removed
added version number to saves popup to prevent loading old saves

notes.title: 0.6.3 Update
notes.content:
Several new features!

* note: save files often don't work between game versions. For now, I've added the ability to opt into a "beta" branch where you can select old versions to opt into, if you want to continue your save on an old branch. Carrying over old saves into new versions is generally not recommended. 

* Can now change player positions. If you change the position, their practice plan for the season will update to the new position.
* Tournament Brackets now work! Once a tournament has been initialized, you can view it by clicking on a day of the tournament and clicking "View Tournament"
* The days of your conference tournament and the end-of-season tournament are now shown as a 'preview' on the calendar to give you a better idea of when they occur!
* Local Mods support for Team Files added! Now, you can create an excel file of teams to use your in game, allowing you the ability to mod in real team names! To get an example file, navigate to the installation folder for College Basketball Manager, go to Content/DataFiles/TeamFiles and you will see a "Default.2025.csv" file there. Copy that file to your MyGames/College_BBall/Mods/TeamFiles/ folder, make any changes you want to see, and then when creating a new legacy, you will have the option to select that mod! NOTE: if you don't have that folder as existing, you may need to create those folders. I'll look into creating that folder by default on startup next update.
* Fixed bug where getting a new staff position approved was not allocating new budget to the position

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.6.1 - Coaching Carousel and More!
notes.content:
If you'd like to join the alpha, you can sign up here! 
collegebasketballmanager.com/JoinBeta


New Features

 The coaching carousel is here! As the season progresses, coaches will lose favor with their athletic director, leading to termination. You can review your own performance in the athletic director’s eyes in the “Performance Review” screen.
 You can view open positions in the new “Available Jobs” screen. As coaches leave for greener pastures, watch their jobs open up as well, leading to a cascade effect that can shake up the entire landscape of college basketball!
 As this cascade effect happens, you can view all the changes in the staff changes log. This will track where coaches have been and where they are going.
 On the other end of the spectrum, when you succeed you can earn achievements (steam achievements integrated as well!). These achievements lead to achievement points, which you can then spend to upgrade your coach by purchasing coach skills!


Smaller Changes/Specifics

Staff Management

 Added staff change log to review coaching changes throughout the season
 New UI for viewing active coach applications for teams
 Added ability to accept/reject coaching offers and apply to teams
 Added UI indicator for interim head coaches
 Added vacancy notifications for head coach positions
 Added video coordinator staff position that reduces film study time by up to 50%


Coach Development

 Implemented comprehensive coach skills system
 Added achievements with Steam integration and unlock notifications
 Added coach skill categories with icons
 Completed coach skill purchasing system with costs varying by coach specialty


Team Management

 Added team history screen showing yearly performance including wins, ranks, and tournament finishes
 Added improved schedule viewer
 Highlighted Selection Sunday on the calendar
 Added support for customizable playoff round names


Performance Review

 Added athletic director approval grades in season reviews
 Updated performance review UI with comprehensive evaluation system
 Added budgeting expectations and approval metrics
 Added program development approval system


Game Simulation & UI

 Added "Complete Season" button for faster game progression
 First pass setup of 2D game simulation with camera view in the UI
 Added calendar indicator for when the transfer portal opens
 Added "My Coach" button to the personal page for quick access
 Improved main menu button visibility with wider outlines


Budget Management

 Implemented budget approval system
 Revamped staff and head coach salary calculations
 Increased base recruiting budgets for all teams
 Increased conference budget distributions


Balance Changes
Recruiting & Player Development

 Streamlined the recruiting process with fewer total recruits
 Adjusted knowledge and interest gain rates to create a more gradual recruiting process
 Reduced penalties for not offering scholarships to recruits
 Removed penalty for revoking scholarships when significantly behind in recruit interest
 Improved player generation to better match position-specific skills and ratings


Coach Management

 Rebalanced how coaches evaluate job offers with greater emphasis on program prestige
 Improved how teams evaluate coaching candidates
 Teams now consider multiple factors when hiring: success, experience, ability, loyalty, reputation, academics, financial management, ethics, and community engagement
 Adjusted athletic director approval system based on personality types
 Made budget performance grades more impactful


Game Balance

 Adjusted free throw ratings to better match recruit generation
 Made player development for learning playbooks more gradual
 Improved potential ratings for recruits with more variability
 Enhanced low post rating to specifically affect post-up plays rather than all inside scoring
 Updated athleticism to better reflect strength and jumping ability
 Raised athleticism variation for shooting guards
 Reduced preseason length from 10 to 5 weeks
 Adjusted early-season ranking changes to be less volatile


Reputation System

 Added reputation consequences for rescinding scholarships
 Added reputation penalties for transferring players
 Added reputation boosts for successful seasons that improve program prestige


Bug Fixes
User Interface

 Fixed issues with achievement display blocking UI input
 Fixed sorting functionality on standings screen
 Fixed player ratings bars incorrectly displaying as green when not improved
 Fixed incorrect values displayed in weekly practice plan
 Fixed player stats showing incorrect years and dates
 Fixed recruiting reports display to accurately show prospect comparisons
 Fixed inconsistent position approval display
 Fixed duplicate offensive/defensive sets being added to practice plans
 


Game Mechanics

 Fixed recruiting reports pricing issue
 Fixed regional recruiting reports for southeast and southwest regions
 Fixed end-of-season progression calculations
 Fixed NET ratings calculation
 Fixed team rankings updates
 Fixed end-of-season crash when advancing to postseason
 Fixed tournament game simulation results not displaying properly
 Fixed AI recruiting priorities for unscouted recruits


Staff & Team Management

 Fixed multiple issues with coaching offer/rejection system
 Fixed bug where coaches would accept multiple jobs in succession
 Fixed issues with coach hiring decision logic
 Fixed bug where teams would hire multiple head coaches
 Fixed coaching staff departures occurring incorrectly
 Fixed team takeover issues with target lists
 Fixed budget display and calculation issues

notes.title: Major Update: Open Alpha Version 0.6.0 Released!
notes.content:
A new major update for the alpha (0.6.0) is out now! 

To join the open alpha, sign up for the mailing list at collegebasketballmanager.com/JoinBeta


Here are the changes:

Transfer Portal System

Dynamic Player Happiness - Players now evaluate their situation based on multiple factors: their playing time compared to expectations, the team's success, and their individual performance on the court.
Transfer Risk Management - Players who become unhappy with their situation may enter the transfer portal, with playing time being a key factor. You'll receive early warnings when players are becoming dissatisfied, giving you time to address their concerns.
Complete Transfer Portal System - Track all available transfers in a new dedicated screen, see their interest in your program, and compete with other schools to land them. The portal opens towards the end of the season.
JUCO Pipeline Added - Junior College recruits are now available as another way to build your program, offering experienced players who can make an immediate impact.

Player Personality System
Player Personalities Matter - Each player now has unique personality traits that affect everything from their development speed to how they handle playing time and team success.
Performance Impact - A player's personality influences how quickly they get tired in practice, how well they learn new plays and schemes, and how they respond to different in-game situations.
Morale Connection - Different personality types respond differently to successes and setbacks - some players need more playing time to stay happy, while others might prioritize team success or individual development.
Scouting Depth - Discover a recruit's personality through your recruiting actions, adding another layer of evaluation when building your program. View detailed personality information in each player's profile.

Morale System
Player Satisfaction Now Matters - Players track their happiness across three main areas: playing time, individual success (stats and development), and team success. Unhappy players may enter the transfer portal.
Each Player Has Different Priorities - A player's personality determines what matters most to them. Some care more about playing time, others about winning or their individual performance. You can discover these priorities through recruiting and regular season interactions.
Early Warning System - You'll receive notifications when players become unhappy, giving you time to address their concerns before they consider transferring. The new UI shows satisfaction trends and grades for each category.

Recruiting System Improvements
Smarter AI Recruiting - AI coaches now make more realistic recruiting decisions by considering program prestige, position needs, signing likelihood, and more. Note: This does make simming between weeks take a few seconds longer.
More Realistic Program Behavior - Top programs now properly target top recruits, while smaller schools focus on more attainable prospects. Each program's recruiting strategy matches their prestige level.
Dynamic Position Needs - Programs now factor in both committed recruits and outstanding scholarship offers when evaluating their roster needs, leading to more balanced recruiting classes.
Improved Player Generation - Recruits now have more varied ratings and potential, creating a more realistic talent pool. Players also start with different levels of offensive knowledge based on their position and basketball IQ.
Transfer Portal Added - Towards the end of the season, the transfer portal will open up as a new way to add talent to your program. Track transferring players' interest in your school and compete with other programs to land them.

Playing Time & Rotation Updates
Major improvements to how minutes are distributed:

Smarter Late-Game Management - Teams now keep their best players in during crucial moments, and starters won't be subbed out too early only to miss important minutes later in the game.
Better AI Substitution Patterns - Computer-controlled teams make smarter decisions about when to sub players in and out, keeping their rotation fresh while ensuring key players are available for critical situations.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed crash caused by game manager and subsequently viewing the game result
Fixed a bug where players could remain in games after fouling out
Fixed crash when sorting recruits by attributes that hadn't been scouted yet
Fixed bug where default rotation could assign negative minutes or more than 40 minutes to players
Fixed crash related to getting coach times when a coaching position was vacant
Fixed bug where interest and knowledge values could exceed 100
Fixed bug where recruit filtering wasn't working correctly for different class types
Fixed issue where starters would get subbed out too early and not return in time to get their expected minutes
Fixed bug where substitutions wouldn't take effect properly during games
Fixed bug where AI would remove offered/committed recruits from their board
Fixed bug sometimes causing an infinite loop while scouting
Fixed bug where the losing team would sometimes run out the clock on their final possession
Fixed bug where committed recruits wouldn't appear in recruit search results
Fixed typo on recruiting board
Fixed interest sort for recruits to properly put committed recruits at the top
Fixed bug requiring rotation check each week of conference games instead of just once
Fixed bug with display of available scholarships after offering a recruit
Fixed bug where personal fouls would result in change of possession when simming with game manager
Fixed bug where trying to sub in fouled out players during crunch time
Fixed bug where player usage wouldn't update based on redshirt status
Fixed crash caused by players appearing in usage gameplan after being removed from team

Quality of life changes:
Made player names more prominent on the roster screen
Changed "Apply to Other Weeks" to "Copy to Other Weeks" in practice templates for better clarity
Added visual outline to calendar day numbers/months to improve readability
Added tooltip information for personality types
Added unofficial campus visit option to quick action bar
Added checklist entry for reviewing unhappy players
Added a more visible checklist entry for rotation check before conference games
Made the checklist for unhappy players only appear once transfer portal is available

Balance changes:
Watching game tape now takes longer
Coach hours have been rebalanced to a lower value
Made potential and work ethic ratings harder to scout accurately
Balanced recruit pitch importance to make pro potential more important for higher-starred recruits
Adjusted default recruit knowledge so they're more aware of team's prestige, championship potential, and pro potential
Unofficial campus visits availability now scales based on recruit's star rating and interest
Made player potential more variable in recruits
“Average” Free throw rating now set to 50 to match current player generation (so a 50 rating would be expected to make an average % of free throws (about 71%))
High IQ recruits have a better chance to learn multiple offenses
Balanced how quickly players learn offensive and defensive sets (was developing too quickly before)
Adjusted player generation to have more appropriate distribution of play types and offensive ratings based on position

Known bugs/balances/quality of life I'm aware of/looking at:

Bugs:
scaling issues when trying to run in windowed mode at less 4:3 or lower resolution (please report any you see)
when managing a game, users can still sub in/use players that have fouled out

Quality of life: 
continue working on tutorials and "Player's Guide" giving a more in-depth tutorial or tips for all aspects of the game
add further tutorials to each page, looking at search for recruits, recruiting board, and recruit popup next.
reviewing more teams' colors to how they mesh with the UI

Features I'm looking at next:
in-game manager (2d movement)
Complete coaching carousel, including all types of staff members
